{{Short description|Football match between Nice and Nantes}} {{Infobox football match | title = 2022 Coupe de France final | image = StadeFranceNationsLeague2018.jpg | image_size = | caption = The [[Stade de France]] hosted the final. | event = [[2021–22 Coupe de France]] | team1 = [[OGC Nice|Nice]] | team1association = [[Ligue 1]] | team1score = 0 | team2 = [[FC Nantes|Nantes]] | team2association = [[Ligue 1]] | team2score = 1 | details = | date = {{Start date|2022|5|7|df=y}} | stadium = [[Stade de France]] | city = [[Saint-Denis, Seine-Saint-Denis|Saint-Denis]] | man_of_the_match1a = | referee = [[Stéphanie Frappart]] | attendance = 78,961 | weather = | previous = [[2021 Coupe de France final|2021]] | next = [[2023 Coupe de France final|2023]] }} The '''2022 Coupe de France final''' was a [[association football|football]] match between [[OGC Nice|Nice]] and [[FC Nantes|Nantes]] to decide the winner of the [[2021–22 Coupe de France]], the 105th season of the [[Coupe de France]]. Originally scheduled to take place on 8 May at the [[Stade de France]] in [[Saint-Denis, Seine-Saint-Denis|Saint-Denis]], [[Paris]], the final was moved to 7 May in consultation with competing clubs and the broadcasters.{{cite web|url=https://www.stadefrance.com/en/ticket/finale-de-la-coupe-de-france-2022|title=2022 French Cup Final|website=stadefrance.com|publisher=Stade De France|date=1 March 2022|access-date=1 March 2022}}{{cite web|url=https://www.worldfootball.net/report/coupe-de-france-2021-2022-finale-n-n-n-n/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220302113538/https://www.worldfootball.net/report/coupe-de-france-2021-2022-finale-n-n-n-n/|url-status=dead|archive-date=March 2, 2022|title=France - Coupe de France 2021/2022 Final|website=WorldFootball.net|publisher=World Football|date=1 March 2022|access-date=1 March 2022}}{{cite web|url=https://www.foot-national.com/coupes/coupe-de-france-la-date-de-la-finale-a-change-763611|title=Coupe de France : La date de la finale et été changée|publisher=foot-national.com|language=fr|date=5 March 2022}} Nantes won the match 1–0 for their fourth Coupe de France title.{{cite web|url=https://www.ligue1.com/Articles/OTHER-COMPETITIONS/2022/05/07/nice-nantes-coupe-de-france-final-blas-french-cup-ineos-dolberg|title=Nantes beat Nice to win Coupe de France|website=ligue1.com|publisher=[[Ligue de Football Professionnel]]|date=7 May 2022|access-date=7 May 2022}}{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/61366648|title=Nice 0–1 Nantes: Ludovic Blas penalty wins French Cup for Nantes|website=BBC Sport|date=7 May 2022|access-date=7 May 2022}} ==Background== Nice reached the final this year for the fifth time in its history, and the first since [[1997 Coupe de France Final|1997]], a game they won over [[En Avant Guingamp|Guingamp]] after a [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] following a 1–1 draw in [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]].{{cite web|url=https://www.footamateur.fr/coupe-de-france-laventure-est-terminee-pour-le-fc-versailles/|title=Coupe de France. L’aventure est terminée pour le FC Versailles|trans-title=Coupe de France. The adventure is over for FC Versailles |language=fr |website=footamateur.fr|publisher=INPI|date=1 March 2022|access-date=6 May 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/60582039 |title=Nice 2–0 Versailles: Fourth-tier side beaten as Nice reached first French Cup final in 25 years|website=BBC Sport|date=1 March 2022|access-date=6 May 2022}} Nantes reached the final this year for the fourth time in its history, having lost at the [[2020–21 Coupe de France#Round of 64|round of 64]] of last year's edition to [[RC Lens|Lens]].{{cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/matches/2021/02/10/france/coupe-de-france/fc-nantes/racing-club-de-lens/3441668/|title=Nantes 2–4 Lens|website=soccerway.com|publisher=Soccerway|date=10 February 2021|access-date=6 May 2022}} This was the first time they reached the final since [[2000 Coupe de France Final|2000]], a game they won over [[Calais RUFC|Calais]].{{cite web|url=https://www.ligue1.com/Articles/OTHER-COMPETITIONS/2022/03/03/coupe-de-france-nantes-topple-monaco|title=Coupe de France: Nantes topple Monaco!|website=ligue1.com|publisher=[[Ligue de Football
